Single-cell pseudobulk graph-cluster inference

Source: R/leviRNAseqInference.R
leviSingleCellGraphInference.Rd

Aggregates cells by donor and cell type, then applies [leviBulkGraphInference] separately to each cell type. Donors, not cells, are permuted.

leviSingleCellGraphInference(
  counts,
  donor,
  cell_type,
  condition,
  min_cells = 10L,
  ...
)

Arguments

counts

Genes-by-cells raw counts.

donor, cell_type

Per-cell donor and cell-type labels.

condition

Named condition vector indexed by donor.

min_cells

Minimum cells required for each donor-cell-type pseudobulk; passed to [leviPseudobulk()].

...

Arguments forwarded to [leviBulkGraphInference].

Value

Named list of cell-type-specific graph inference results.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE)) {
# \donttest{
  set.seed(1)
  genes <- c("HUB", paste0("N", 1:8))
  donor <- rep(paste0("d", 1:6), each = 4)
  cell_type <- rep(rep(c("A", "B"), each = 2), 6)
  counts <- matrix(rpois(length(genes) * length(donor), 30), length(genes),
    dimnames = list(genes, NULL))
  treated <- donor %in% c("d4", "d5", "d6")
  counts[, treated] <- counts[, treated] + 30L
  condition <- c(d1 = "C", d2 = "C", d3 = "C", d4 = "T", d5 = "T", d6 = "T")
  out <- leviSingleCellGraphInference(counts, donor, cell_type,
    condition = condition, min_cells = 2,
    networkCoordinatesInput = system.file("extdata", "hub_network.dat", package = "levi"),
    fileTypeInput = "dat", test = "T", control = "C", threshold = 1,
    n_perm = 3, seed = 1)
  names(out)
# }
}
